basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old tech enthusiast and DIY hobbyist living in Portland, Oregon. I work as a mechanical engineer during the day, and in my free time, I tinker with electronics and various tech projects. I have a keen interest in automotive technology, particularly electric vehicles, which led me to purchase a 2016 Kia Soul EV. I'm also an avid gamer, enjoying cooperative games like Generation Zero. My evenings are typically spent exploring new Reddit threads, particularly in the evenings after work. I'm currently single and enjoy my solitude, but I do appreciate the camaraderie of online communities.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Mechanical Engineering, I've always been drawn to understanding how things work. My job has given me a solid foundation in engineering principles, but I'm largely self-taught in the realm of DIY electronics and automotive modifications. I often dive into online resources and forums to expand my knowledge, particularly in emerging tech and sustainable transportation.
